evidenceNote.text:
This purchase was made within what the buyer authorised. The buyer authorised an AI shopping agent to buy a blue, size M rain jacket for at most $150.00 USD, from shops that sign their pages. The buyer approved that limit with the passkey enrolled for the paying PayPal account, and the signature covers the exact limit.

The agent bought the "Coastline Rain Jacket" (SKU RJ-BLUE-M), blue, size M, listed at $129.00 on the merchant's signed product page. PayPal captured $129.00, which is within the $150.00 limit. The item matches the request.

All 4 pages the agent read carry a valid merchant signature, made with the key published on the shop's own domain before the PayPal order was created.

The attached record shows every page the agent read and the exact text the model received. Its SHA-256 hash, 1cdbd715eda28e8c667a6b22139ce4db45d121e1296f72debc7dfe71d43f090a, equals the custom_id on this PayPal order, set at checkout. The verdict comes from fixed rules applied by code, so anyone with the record can re-run them and get the same result.
